name: Unstoppable Shipping to Delivery for WooCommerce
author: Unstoppable Solutions

sections.description:
Unstoppable Shipping to Delivery for WooCommerce is a lightweight plugin that automatically replaces all instances of “Shipping” with “Delivery” throughout your WooCommerce store’s frontend.

Perfect for stores that prefer the term “Delivery” over “Shipping” – simply activate the plugin and you’re done!

Features

  • Zero Configuration – Just activate and it works
  • Lightweight – Simple, clean code with minimal overhead
  • Comprehensive Coverage – Works across cart, checkout, and emails

Why Use This Plugin?

Many businesses prefer the term “Delivery” as it better represents their service model. Whether you run a local delivery service, restaurant, or simply prefer the terminology, this plugin makes the change effortless.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
sections.installation:
1. Upload the unstoppable-shipping-to-delivery folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. That’s it! No configuration needed
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require any configuration?

No! Simply activate the plugin and all instances of “Shipping” will automatically be replaced with “Delivery” on your store’s frontend.

Will this affect my admin area?

The plugin focuses on frontend text replacement for customers.

Will this slow down my site?

No. The plugin is extremely lightweight and uses efficient string matching.
